known_differences: The native Stitch desktop output is a simplified generic SaaS layout and its thumbnail omits much of the official portrait and interface media. It is preserved separately; the hosted study uses captured official public media.

The mobile request also returned a DESKTOP screen and a mail-only phone reference image inconsistent with the current multi-product homepage. Only its third screen is labeled MOBILE; all outputs are preserved for provenance.
The source HTTP snapshot lacks current browser-rendered hero copy, so the observed browser DOM and imagery guided the hosted study rather than assuming the server HTML represented the visual page.

The public draft approximates the official sky video, person cutout, floating interface panels, sticky navigation, suite tabs, product sections, manifesto, and footer. It does not reproduce complete animations, original forms, all mega menus, and responsive behavior.
Rendered side-by-side desktop and mobile comparison remains pending. Exact visual parity is unverified.
